hero.eyebrow: What's holding your company back from its next level?
hero.title: The growth platform for SaaS founders in public services
hero.sub: We partner with founders who've built great software for the public sector — and help them break through the barriers that limit growth. Whether it's a local market, technical debt, lack of AI capability, or simply building alone — PubliX gives you the resources, the network, and the community to scale.
hero.micro: Confidential · No obligation · Founder to founder
hero.proof: 6 founder-led companies already in the group
hero.img_alt: Team meeting at a PubliX portfolio company

usp1.title: Your customers are already our customers
usp1.p1: When companies serving the same public-sector clients join the same group, something powerful happens: cross-selling becomes natural. Your scheduling platform is already deployed in the municipality that needs our grants management system.
usp1.p2: Instead of competing for attention, our portfolio companies open doors for each other — shared customer relationships, joint marketing resources, and warm introductions that would take years to build alone.
usp1.card1_text: Your products reach new customers through existing, trusted relationships in the group.
usp1.card2_text: Pool resources for events, campaigns and content aimed at the same decision-makers.
usp1.card3_text: Cross-selling across the portfolio drives organic top-line growth for every company.
usp1.card4_text: Skip the cold outreach — get introduced by a colleague the customer already trusts.

usp2.eyebrow: Losing tenders you should be winning?
usp2.title: We've run more public procurements than anyone
usp2.p1: Public procurement is complex, bureaucratic and unforgiving. Miss a requirement, lose the deal. For a single company, each tender is a costly bet.
usp2.p2: With multiple portfolio companies, PubliX runs more public tenders, across more municipalities, more often than any individual company could. That volume gives us a structural advantage — we know the process, we know the pitfalls, and we have dedicated resources to help you win.
usp2.p3: Plus shared IT infrastructure, security auditing and compliance frameworks that meet the toughest public-sector standards.
usp2.li1: Dedicated procurement specialists across the group
usp2.li2: Shared compliance and IT security frameworks
usp2.li3: Volume advantage: more tenders, more municipalities, more wins
usp2.li4: Template library from hundreds of successful bids
usp2.li5: Legal review and risk assessment for every submission

usp3.eyebrow: Worried about losing control of your company?
usp3.title: We don't change what works. We build on it.
usp3.p1: When we acquire a company, we're not buying a product — we're investing in the people and organisation that built it.
usp3.p2: Every company in our group keeps its own brand, its own office, and its own decision-making authority. You won't become a faceless product line inside a giant.
usp3.p3: Instead, we invest in developing that existing value — through shared learning, cross-company competence building, and the kind of strategic support that helps founders focus on what they do best: building great products.
usp3.li1: Your brand stays. Your identity is part of your value.
usp3.li2: Your decision-making stays. The roadmap remains yours.
usp3.li3: Your office stays. You operate from where you are.
usp3.li4: Your culture stays. We add resources, not restrictions.
usp3.quote: "We joined PubliX to grow faster — and the first thing they told us was 'keep doing what you're doing, we're here to help.'"

usp4.eyebrow: Is AI making your product obsolete?
usp4.title: Embedded AI capability from day one
usp4.p1: If you've built a successful SaaS company over the past 10 or 20 years, you already know: AI will fundamentally change the competitive landscape. New products, new pricing, new expectations.
usp4.p2: PubliX gives you access to dedicated AI and technology expertise — not as a consultant engagement, but as an embedded capability. We help you modernise your tech stack, automate internal processes, build AI-powered features, and develop new go-to-market strategies.
usp4.p3: The companies that adapt fastest will win. We want you on that journey with us.
usp4.card1_text: Integrate AI into your product to deliver more value and differentiate from competitors.
usp4.card2_text: AI-driven lead generation, qualification and outreach to accelerate your pipeline.
usp4.card3_text: Automate internal workflows — support, onboarding, billing — to free up your team.
usp4.card4_text: Market intelligence, pricing optimisation and competitive analysis powered by AI.

usp5.eyebrow: Ready to grow beyond your home market?
usp5.title: Take your product beyond the Nordics
usp5.p1: Your product works in your home market. It could work across Europe. But international expansion requires market knowledge, legal expertise, and localisation capabilities that are hard to build from scratch.
usp5.p2: PubliX already has pan-Nordic presence and is currently expanding into Northern Europe, the British and the DACH region. We bring market intelligence, legal frameworks, language capabilities and marketing expertise that make it possible for our companies to launch in new markets.
usp5.p3: The European public sector is a massive, under-digitised market. We help you get there.
usp5.li1: Active operations in Sweden, Finland and Denmark today
usp5.li2: Market intelligence and regulatory mapping for European expansion
usp5.li3: Legal expertise for new jurisdictions and public procurement
usp5.li4: Localisation — language, marketing and cultural adaptation
usp5.li5: International investor network through Aspira Partners

team.title: Operators, not financiers
team.sub: PubliX is led by people who have built, scaled and operated software companies. When you talk to us, you talk to someone who has done the job you're doing.
team.bio_hubel: Alexander has spent over 15 years building and scaling software companies. Before joining PubliX Group, he held leadership roles across SaaS, digital transformation, and M&A. He leads the group's strategy, acquisitions, and founder relationships.
team.bio_astrom: Marcus brings deep experience in M&A and corporate finance, with a focus on technology companies. He leads the deal process from first conversation to close, ensuring every transaction is structured fairly and transparently.
team.bio_runsten: Erik oversees the group's financial operations and reporting. With a background in finance and operations across technology companies, he ensures our portfolio companies have the financial infrastructure to scale.
team.bio_zeits: Patrick leads the technical strategy across the group, including AI capabilities, shared infrastructure, and software architecture. He works hands-on with every portfolio company's development team.
team.bio_sallner: Patrik is an experienced technology executive and board professional. As Chairman of the Board, he provides strategic guidance and governance oversight to the group.
team.bio_wrede: Viktor brings investment and technology expertise to the board as an independent external director. He contributes to PubliX's strategic direction and portfolio company development.
team.bio_barklof: Anders represents Aspira Partners on the PubliX Group board. He brings deep experience in building and scaling Nordic technology companies.
team.bio_holm: Anton represents Aspira Partners on the PubliX Group board. He contributes investment expertise and supports the group's acquisition and growth strategy.
team.bio_salmi_board: Janne co-founded Koivu Solutions and serves on the PubliX Group board as an entrepreneur representative. He brings firsthand experience in scaling Finnish healthcare technology into new Nordic markets.
team.bio_tornqvist_board: Alexander co-founded digiPlant and serves on the PubliX Group board as an entrepreneur representative. He brings hands-on SaaS founder experience and deep knowledge of grant management technology.
team.bio_hjort: Adam leads Tidvis, whose platform runs the daily operations of Swedish personal assistance and LSS providers. His understanding of care workers' everyday reality drives the platform's design and development.
team.bio_tornqvist_leader: Alexander co-founded digiPlant to modernise how foundations and grant providers handle applications. Since joining PubliX, his team has continued to build out SBS Manager.
team.bio_tanner: Harri leads Aspicore, whose Apuraha4 platform manages the full grant lifecycle for Finnish foundations, universities and public authorities — built on two decades of work with grant systems.
team.bio_salmi_leader: Janne co-founded Koivu Solutions and built Sotender, the platform that connects Finnish healthcare workers with open shifts and reduces reliance on staffing agencies.
team.bio_rydberg: Johan leads Embrace Safety, helping municipalities and police authorities run knowledge-based crime prevention and safety promotion work.

lead.title: Discover your growth potential
lead.sub: We offer a select number of founders a confidential, in-depth growth assessment — a serious analysis of how your company could scale with the right resources. More markets, stronger products, AI capabilities, reduced technical debt. This isn't a generic report. It's a bespoke process, delivered personally by our CEO.
lead.s1_text: Tell us who you are and what your company does. We review every application personally.
lead.s2_text: If there's a potential fit, we set up a confidential conversation and sign a mutual NDA to protect both sides.
lead.s3_text: New markets, product expansion, AI capabilities, technical debt reduction and competitive positioning — tailored to your company.
lead.s4_text: Your assessment is delivered in a private meeting, founder to founder. The insights are yours — no obligation, no pressure.
lead.form_sub: We review every application personally. All information is treated as strictly confidential.
lead.success_msg: Thank you for your application. Alexander will be in touch personally within a few business days.
lead.vertical_ph: Briefly describe your product and the public-sector customers you serve
lead.legal: Your application goes directly to Alexander Hübel, Group CEO. All information is confidential. We respond to every application within 3 business days.

testi.eyebrow: What do founders who joined say?
testi.title: Don't take our word for it
testi.t1_quote: We chose PubliX specifically because we believe in the public sector as a market for players like us. In PubliX we've found a context with a clear market focus, where together we grow stronger and can build something stable and lasting for the future.
testi.t2_quote: My father founded the company 35 years ago and served as CEO ever since, so ensuring a smooth succession was our priority. PubliX is bringing in a CTO we couldn't have hired ourselves, along with the knowledge and new ideas to modernise our product with AI.
testi.t3_quote: One important reason for us to join PubliX was to expand into Sweden and other markets. Through discussions with the other PubliX CEOs, they've already introduced us to municipalities and regions in Sweden — and now we're planning our next market.

cta.title: Thinking about your next chapter?
cta.sub: Whether you're exploring your options, curious about where your company stands, or just want to talk to someone who understands your market — we'd welcome the conversation.
cta.micro: Every application is reviewed personally by our CEO
